description.value: City Avenue Market is a family-owned organic and natural grocery chain founded in Vancouver in 1986, with the Port Coquitlam location on Shaughnessy Street opening in January 2016. The store focuses on fresh, local, and organic produce alongside a broad selection of bulk items, dairy, meat, and a deli now operating at this location. It was voted a favourite local grocery in the 2025 NW A-List and PoCo A-List, offering online shopping and delivery in addition to in-store shopping.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms City Avenue Market is an active, multi-location organic and natural grocery chain, with the Port Coquitlam location at 120–2627 Shaughnessy Street matching the OSM address. The website lists a general customer service number (604-255-1440) that differs from the OSM store-specific number (+1-604-945-7741), flagged as a concern. No bike parking, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; basic grocery categories (produce, dairy, meat, deli, bulk) are explicitly confirmed.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy: OSM lists +1-604-945-7741 (likely store-specific), but the website contact page shows 604-255-1440 as the customer service number. The OSM number may be the direct store line; recommend verifying which is correct for the Port Coquitlam location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible organic grocery store with a confirmed Port Coquitlam location and strong web presence; useful to touring cyclists for resupply.
